title: Cloth Armour

sources.title: Grievous Retribution
markers: | description = When an enemy damages the wearer, the wearer gains {{Cond|Wrath}} for 2 turns.

summary: Clothing with base AC 10. Once per turn when an enemy damages you, gain 2 turns of Wrath. Each remaining turn adds +1 to melee weapon damage, to a maximum of 7.

fields.Effect: Clothing with base AC 10. Once per turn when an enemy damages you, gain 2 turns of Wrath. Each remaining turn adds +1 to melee weapon damage, to a maximum of 7.
fields.Base value: 250 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
